For instance, a long position in VIX futures could be considered as having negative market exposure (since VIX often increases when the market falls), and a short position in VIX futures as positive market exposure. Hedge with Mini-S&P Futures: Based on the assessed market exposure from the VIX futures position, take an oflsetting position in mini-S&P futures. If the VIX futures position has negative market exposure, a long position in mini-S&P futur es would hedge this risk, and vice versa.
